أتشاعر (form VI)
# أَتَشَاعَرُ (ʔatašāʕaru) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ʕa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# أَتَشَاعَرَ (ʔatašāʕara) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ʕa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
# أَتَشَاعَرْ (ʔatašāʕar) /ʔa.ta.ʃaː.ʕar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَاعَرَ (tašāʕara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
